entity_review_queue_resolution_check.name: entity_review_queue_resolution_check
entity_review_queue_resolution_check.value:
("entity_review_queue"."status" = 'open' AND "entity_review_queue"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("entity_review_queue"."status" <> 'open' AND "entity_review_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

match_results_pens_need_aet_check.name: match_results_pens_need_aet_check
match_results_pens_need_aet_check.value: "match_results"."pens_home" IS NULL OR "match_results"."aet_home" IS NOT NULL

match_stats_possession_pair_check.name: match_stats_possession_pair_check
match_stats_possession_pair_check.value:
("match_stats"."home_possession" IS NULL AND "match_stats"."away_possession" IS NULL)
          OR ("match_stats"."home_possession" + "match_stats"."away_possession" BETWEEN 99 AND 101)

match_stats_home_sot_le_shots_check.name: match_stats_home_sot_le_shots_check
match_stats_home_sot_le_shots_check.value:
"match_stats"."home_shots_on_target" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_shots" IS NULL
          OR "match_stats"."home_shots_on_target" <= "match_stats"."home_shots"

match_stats_away_sot_le_shots_check.name: match_stats_away_sot_le_shots_check
match_stats_away_sot_le_shots_check.value:
"match_stats"."away_shots_on_target" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_shots" IS NULL
          OR "match_stats"."away_shots_on_target" <= "match_stats"."away_shots"

match_stats_counts_nonneg_check.name: match_stats_counts_nonneg_check
match_stats_counts_nonneg_check.value:
("match_stats"."home_shots" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_shots" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."away_shots" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_shots" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."home_corners" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_corners" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."away_corners" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_corners" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."home_fouls" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_fouls" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."away_fouls" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_fouls" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."home_yellow_cards" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_yellow_cards" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."away_yellow_cards" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_yellow_cards" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."home_red_cards" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_red_cards" >= 0)
          AND ("match_stats"."away_red_cards" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_red_cards" >= 0)

match_stats_xg_nonneg_check.name: match_stats_xg_nonneg_check
match_stats_xg_nonneg_check.value: ("match_stats"."home_xg" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."home_xg" >= 0) AND ("match_stats"."away_xg" IS NULL OR "match_stats"."away_xg" >= 0)

seasons_dates_check.name: seasons_dates_check
seasons_dates_check.value: "seasons"."end_date" IS NULL OR "seasons"."start_date" IS NULL OR "seasons"."end_date" >= "seasons"."start_date"

venues_closed_after_opened_check.name: venues_closed_after_opened_check
venues_closed_after_opened_check.value: "venues"."closed_year" IS NULL OR "venues"."opened_year" IS NULL OR "venues"."closed_year" >= "venues"."opened_year"
